newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India offers Aug 18-20 Madras naphtha by tender.
newsitem.headline: India offers Aug 18-20 Madras naphtha by tender.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to sell 25,000 tonnes of low aromatic naphtha (LAN) for August 18-20 lifting from Madras on the east coast, industry sources said on Monday.
The tender closes on August 7 and bids will be valid for one day.
IOC has already sold one August LAN cargo from Madras for August 6-8 lifting to South Korea's Hanwha Chemical Corp at around $19 per tonne below Japanese spot quotes, on a free-on-board (fob) basis.
